title: Base change for the right adjoint of pushforward under Tor independence, in three cases
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)

difficulty_reason: In diagram labelled equation-base-change, with g : Y' -> Y a morphism of affine schemes, f : X -> Y proper, and f and g Tor independent, the lemma asserts that the base change map of equation labelled equation-base-change-map induces an isomorphism L(g')^*a(K) -> a'(Lg^*K) in three cases: for all K in D_QCoh(O_Y) when f is flat of finite presentation, for all such K when f is perfect and Y is Noetherian, and for K in D_QCoh^+(O_Y) when g has finite Tor dimension and Y is Noetherian (statement lines 1635-1657). Writing Y = Spec(A) and Y' = Spec(A'), the proof picks a perfect generator M of D_QCoh(O_X) by Derived Categories of Schemes, Theorem labelled perfect-theorem-bondal-van-den-Bergh, notes that L(g')^*M is a generator, and reduces to the isomorphism of the global Hom complexes of equation labelled equation-iso, which suffices because the cone of L(g')^*a(K) -> a'(Lg^*K) then vanishes (proof lines 1659-1683). It then computes both sides: the left side becomes RHom_Y(Rf_*M, K) otimes^L_A A' using Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-affine-morphism-and-hom-out-of-perfect and Lemma labelled lemma-iso-global-hom, while the right side becomes RHom_{Y'}(Lg^*Rf_*M, Lg^*K) after the base change isomorphism of Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-compare-base-change (proof lines 1685-1707). The comparison map beta is identified with More on Algebra, Equation labelled more-algebra-equation-base-change-RHom, and is an isomorphism in the three cases by listing respectively Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-flat-proper-perfect-direct-image-general with More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-base-change-RHom part (1), More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-perfect-proper-perfect-direct-image with part (1) again, and Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemmas labelled perfect-lemma-direct-image-coherent and perfect-lemma-identify-pseudo-coherent-noetherian with part (4) (proof lines 1709-1731). The last part of the proof checks that the two identifications really are induced by equation labelled equation-iso, by writing the large commutative diagram with the alpha maps, the beta map and the maps mu, mu' built from the invertible transformation g'_* o a' -> a o g_* of Lemma labelled lemma-flat-precompose-pus, and reducing to the commutativity of a triangle between RHom_A(E, K), RHom_{A'}(E otimes^L A', K otimes^L A') and RHom_A(E, K otimes^L A'), which holds by the construction of beta in More on Algebra, Section labelled more-algebra-section-base-change-RHom (proof lines 1733-1823). Tracking which of the four comparison maps is the one induced by the base change map, through the generator argument and the two diagram chases, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
